description:
The organization operates a high-volume online marketplace focused on providing collectors and investors with a wide selection of items at competitive prices. As the company continues to scale, they are investing heavily in platform performance, infrastructure, and customer experience.

This role combines hands-on Magento development with technical leadership and project management responsibilities. The individual will serve as the internal technical owner of the Magento platform while managing external development teams and vendors. The ideal candidate is comfortable both writing and reviewing code while leading strategic initiatives that improve platform performance and scalability.

Key Responsibilities 
 Perform hands-on Magento development including configuration updates, enhancements, and bug fixes
 Support both front-end and back-end improvements including themes, modules, and extensions
 Troubleshoot performance issues, site errors, and platform functionality
 Support staging, QA, and production deployment processes
 Review and validate external vendor code prior to deployment
 Help optimize site speed, checkout flow, and overall user experience
 Ensure security best practices and platform updates are maintained
 Manage and coordinate work with external Magento development partners
 Define project scope, timelines, and deliverables for development initiatives
 Translate business goals into technical requirements for development teams
 Prioritize development initiatives and manage the platform roadmap
 Oversee testing, release management, and deployment processes
 Improve internal documentation and development workflows
 Evaluate Magento architecture to ensure scalability and long-term performance
 Identify opportunities for automation and operational improvements
 Recommend platform upgrades, integrations, and tools that enhance the customer experience
 Serve as the internal subject matter expert for Magento and related eCommerce systems

Qualifications 
 Strong hands-on experience with Magento (Adobe Commerce or Magento Open Source)
 Experience managing external development teams or vendors
 Ability to review and validate development code and technical implementations
 Understanding of Magento architecture, extensions, and integrations
 Familiarity with APIs and third-party eCommerce integrations
 Strong project management and organizational skills
 Ability to balance hands-on development work with technical leadership responsibilities
 Excellent communication skills when working with both technical and non-technical teams
